description: Listen to a short story or a direction, then tap the big picture.

tier.name: Starting support
tier.range: Classroom support choice; not a WIDA proficiency level

A.studentGoal: I can listen and tap the picture I hear.

info.headline: I can listen and tap the picture I hear.
info.summary: One word or one short sentence.
canDo: I can listen and tap the picture I hear.

activities.title: Find the Cat
activities.script: Find the cat. The cat says meow.
vocabulary: a small pet that says meow
gato: mascota pequeña que dice miau
activities.hint: Tap 'Hear it again' as many times as you want. Tap the speaker on a picture to hear its name.
activities.support: Tap 'Hear it again' as many times as you want. Tap the speaker on a picture to hear its name.
activities.extension: Tell a grown-up one more thing that happened in the story.
wida: Identify a named object from oral input

teacher.use: Whole group or a listening center with headphones. The player reads the directions and the story aloud; listening for an animal word.
teacher.lower: Play the story twice. Point to each picture choice as the player names it. Accept a pointed answer.
teacher.onLevel: Play once, let the child choose, then ask them to say the answer in a short sentence.
teacher.challenge: After the answer, ask a why or what-next question about the story.
teacher.noTech: Read the script aloud from the teacher packet and hold up picture cards for the choices.
teacher.prompt: What did you hear that helped you choose?

activities.title: Ana Helps
activities.directions: Listen to the story. Tap what Ana does.
activities.directionsEs: Escucha el cuento. Toca lo que hace Ana.
activities.script: Ana has a watering can. She waters the seeds. Grow, seeds, grow!
vocabulary: to give a plant a drink
regar: darle agua a una planta
small things that grow into plants
